FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Manager, Trinkets & Treasures, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@trinketsandtreasures.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Trinkets & Treasures, we specialize in a diverse range of gift and souvenir items including handmade crafts, locally sourced artwork, and unique memorabilia that reflect the charm of Springfield. Our welcoming store is designed to provide an enjoyable shopping experience for both tourists and local customers alike. We maintain strict inventory management procedures to minimize loss and ensure timely restocking of popular items. Our team is trained in customer service, safety protocols, and loss prevention strategies. Operating from a permanent retail location, we fully comply with local regulations and maintain all necessary business licenses. We are committed to fostering community engagement, collaborating with local artisans, and actively participating in regional events to support our vibrant arts scene.

Our gift and souvenir shop offers a unique selection of novelty items, including decorative collectibles and themed fireworks for local celebrations and events.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses to report. Business operates without any insurance claims or incidents related to firearms, hazardous materials, or other excluded operations.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel vault, Class I, labeled for cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Operational security systems, including professional monitoring and intrusion detection, to enhance safety and theft prevention.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not engage in operations involving storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The shop focuses on retailing a variety of gift items without any hazardous components.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not sponsor athletic teams. The focus of the business is on retailing gift and souvenir items.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as it ensures proper risk transfer. Certificates are typically checked by the management of Trinkets & Treasures to maintain compliance and safety standards.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Trinkets & Treasures has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crime in connection with this or any other property. The business maintains a strong commitment to compliance and operational integrity.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Trinkets & Treasures has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. The business operates without any insurance claims or incidents related to excluded operations.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not lease employees to or from other employers. The business operates with its own staff without engaging in employee leasing arrangements.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as it is not applicable for this retail operation. The business complies with all local regulations and maintains necessary business licenses.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not own or operate any other business apart from its gift and souvenir shop. The business is solely focused on retailing a variety of gift items without any additional operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The business focuses solely on its retail operations without additional underwriting needs.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Trinkets & Treasures is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The shop specializes in retailing gift and souvenir items without any manufacturing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on retailing gift and souvenir items. This allows us to maintain our commitment to safety and regulatory compliance.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Trinkets & Treasures has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, ensuring a stable financial history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as we focus exclusively on retailing non-hazardous gift and souvenir items. Our operations are fully compliant with local regulations and do not involve any hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Trinkets & Treasures does not sell firearms, ammunition, fireworks, or hazardous materials, which exempts them from such catastrophe exposures.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Trinkets & Treasures has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, ensuring a strong commitment to compliance and safety.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Trinkets & Treasures has no uncorrected fire code violations and prioritizes compliance with all safety regulations. The business maintains a commitment to operational safety and regulatory standards.
